run_slurm_experiment: run a single torchbeast experiment on a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable actors
run_run_function: run a torchbeast single machine job by submitting subprocess arguments through a submitit executor
run_log_dir_root: run the log_dir_root function to get the local or cluster log directory path for torchbeast
run_main_function: run the main function to create an executor, submit a job, and symlink the latest log directory
review_run_function: review the run function that builds subprocess arguments and submits them via a submitit executor
